To give an idea of the proof, let us first consider the case when s = 0. In this case we are setting out to prove that for a generic linear subspace U ⊆ V of dimension not too large, it holds that S d (U ) ∩ K = {0}. This seems to be an interesting multilinear algebraic question in its own right.
